title: Semantic Enrichments Fields (part of composed schema)
description: Semantic enrichments fields of media content items in the Impresso project.

ocrqa_f.description: OCR quality assessment score between 0.00 and 1.00, or null if unavailable.

nag_mentions.description: List of mentions from news agencies.

nag_offset_plain.description: Offsets for news agency mentions in plain text.

nag_mention_conf_dpfs.description: Confidence scores for news agency mentions.

pers_mentions.description: List of detected person mention surface strings extracted from the content (may contain duplicates).

pers_mention_conf_dpfs.description: List of person mention confidence annotations; each entry is typically a string combining mention and confidence in the pipeline format (for example: 'Mention text|95.2').

pers_entities_dpfs.description: Serialized person entity annotations (for example qid/identifier or JSON fragment) produced by the entity recognition pipeline.

loc_mentions.description: List of detected location mention surface strings extracted from the content.

loc_mention_conf_dpfs.description: List of location mention confidence annotations; entries typically encode mention and confidence (e.g. 'Location|87.3').

loc_entities_dpfs.description: Serialized location entity annotations (identifier or JSON) assigned to the detected location mentions.

org_mentions.description: List of detected organization mention surface strings extracted from the content.

org_mention_conf_dpfs.description: List of organization mention confidence annotations; strings typically combine mention and confidence (e.g. 'Org name|75.4').

org_entities_dpfs.description: Serialized organization entity annotations (identifier or JSON) assigned to the detected organization mentions.

nem_offset_plain.description: Offsets for named entity mentions in plain text.

topics_dpfs.description: Topics assigned to the content item.

cluster_id_ss.description: TR Cluster IDs assigned to the content item.

gte_multi_v768.description: Content item embedding as a vector of floats.
